events.title: Earnings spotlight: Why CVS, Uber, Super Micro stocks are surging
events.body: In today's segment of Trending Tickers, Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman outlines why shares of CVS (CVS), Uber (UBER), and Super Micro Computer (SMCI) are all surging in Wednesday's trading session.
